# PlxNative Player HUD bundles 1.0

- Authoring: AUTHORING.md and AGENTS.md
- Manifest schema: schema/manifest/1.0.json
- HUD schema: schema/hud/1.0.json
- Minimal source: examples/minimal/manifest.json and examples/minimal/hud.json
- Reference source: examples/reference/manifest.json, hud.json and assets/*.svg
- Native artifacts: examples/minimal.plxhud and examples/reference.plxhud
- Invalid source cases: examples/invalid/<case>/manifest.json and hud.json
- Full format: https://github.com/GLinnik21/plx-native/blob/main/docs/hud-plugins.md

Use the native SDK for packaging, schema export, inspection, all-language linting and previews.
The manifest and HUD have independent version axes, initially 1.0. The archive SHA256 identifies
the exact complete package. Resource semantics remain app-owned SVG masks in the first delivery.
